description: This file contains an extension to the CanvasWindowController class, providing functions to create, present, reposition, and manage the window or panel used for displaying a canvas in a macOS application. It handles window styling, positioning, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures a new NSWindow or panel based on the presentation type (window or panel) with predefined styles and properties.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Presents the panel anchored at a specific position, bringing it to the front and activating the app.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Recalculates and sets the panel's frame based on an anchor point, stored frame, or default positioning, respecting agent preferences.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates the default frame for the panel at the top-right position of a given screen with minimum size constraints.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel on the specified screen, constraining it to visible bounds and persisting its position if it is a panel.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the screen containing a given anchor rectangle.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen currently under the mouse cursor.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks whether a given frame is substantially visible within a specified screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Adjusts a frame to ensure it fits within a visible screen area, respecting minimum size constraints.

methods.name: windowWillClose
methods.description: Handles window close events by updating visibility state.

methods.name: windowDidMove
methods.description: Handles the event of the window being moved, persisting its new position.

methods.name: windowDidEndLiveResize
methods.description: Handles resize end events, persisting the window's frame.

methods.name: persistFrameIfPanel
methods.description: Stores the current frame of the panel if applicable.
